# Support

If you need help with `geocr-mcp-server`:

- **Documentation**: Read the [README.md](../README.md) for tool usage, configuration, and workflows.
- **Specification Reference**: Use the `get_geocroissant_spec_reference` tool or refer to the [GeoCroissant specification](http://mlcommons.org/croissant/geo/1.0).
- **Issues**: Search existing [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/HarshShinde0/geocr_mcp/issues) or open a new issue.
